statement: Build Tap Rush, a 30-second reaction game, as one self-contained web page playable by tap or click on a phone or laptop with no login.
audience: Anyone on a phone or laptop, no login needed
standards: Dark background, bright coloured circles, large text
Works on a 360px wide phone with no horizontal scrolling
Controls are tap or mouse click only
One page in one file, no external images, fonts or scripts
rules: Use exactly: game name "Tap Rush", round length 30 seconds, circle lifetime 1 second, 1 point per circle
No sign-up forms, no contact details, no prices
Do not invent anything the brief does not state; mark it to be confirmed or ask
Add no features beyond the three screens described
done_when: The start screen shows the name "Tap Rush"
The start screen has one line of instructions and a "Start" button
The play screen shows a visible score and a countdown timer
A round lasts exactly 30 seconds, then the end screen appears
Coloured circles appear at random spots in the play area, and tapping or clicking one adds exactly 1 point
Each circle disappears 1 second after it appears if not tapped
The end screen shows the final score, the best score this session and a "Play again" button that starts a new round
The only controls are tap or mouse click
The page has a dark background, bright circles and large text
There is no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px width
The file is one page with no external images, fonts or scripts, and has no sign-up form, contact details or prices
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Start a round from a start screen
See score and countdown while playing
Tap or click circles to score
See final score and best score this session, then play again
